decisions.reason: Its visible adoption by a major public client and links to over 30 governmental APIS schemes put performance clearly above a reasonable aspiration level, so a large expanding firm is very unlikely to withdraw it.

Although public evidence of results is limited, it remains on the website, fits the firm's travel-compliance capabilities, and organisational slack supports keeping it while management waits for clearer performance signals.

As a close extension of the firm's established document and travel security offer, it likely benefits from bundling and customer overlap, making retention more likely unless results soon fall clearly below aspirations.
